line 422, function teleport_to: while loop walking down until a solid block, bounded by y > 0
lines 521-524, function enderman_attack_entity_from: up to 64 teleport attempts (bounded, dead in the probe)

Java func_ names for the carried-block accessors are MCP guesses, not checked against EntityEnderman.java.
